pick.name: Granola
pick.why: Best summaries and templates without a visible bot; audio deleted after transcription, SOC 2 Type II and DPA on all plans.
pick.free_limits: Basic $0: bot-free device-audio capture, 30 days of meeting history; Business $14/user/mo (unlimited history); Enterprise $35/user/mo

best_free.name: Meetily
best_free.what: Local botless recorder + Whisper transcription + optional local-LLM summaries
best_free.why: Free, open source, nothing leaves the device.
best_free.free_limits: Free; summaries via local Ollama or own API key

alts.name: Fathom
alts.what: Free unlimited recording and AI summaries
alts.why: Most generous free cloud plan; bot capture by default, bot-free option is a Mac beta.
alts.free_limits: Free forever with unlimited recordings; some AI features limited

alts.name: Buzz
alts.why: Stable offline transcriber: record anywhere, transcribe locally.

candidates.name: Fathom
candidates.verdict: alt: free but bot by default

decision: Botless capture avoids bots joining customer interviews; Granola is the polished choice. Choose a local tool (Meetily/Buzz) when recordings cannot leave the device or for regulated clients; for cloud tools check where data is stored and that a DPA exists. Always get consent to record.
details: Pick changed from Meetily to Granola on overall quality; Meetily is now best_free.

region_notes.EU: Cloud tools: check data residency and DPA (GDPR); local tools avoid transfers.
region_notes.India: DPDP Act consent and client NDAs apply.
region_notes.US: Two-party-consent states require everyone to agree to recording.

verify.note: The official pricing page shows 'Download for Windows' on every tier, so Windows is confirmed. Best overall holds against Fathom, Otter and tl;dv for bot-free interviews.
